description: Defines the CandidateHistory entity class for ORM, mapping to the ohrm_job_candidate_history table in the database. Contains properties and methods for managing candidate history records in an HRM system, including relationships to Candidate, Vacancy, Interview, and Employee entities.

classes.name: CandidateHistory
classes.description: A Doctrine ORM entity representing the history of candidate actions, with annotations for database mapping and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the candidate history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the candidate history record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity associated with this history record.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this history record.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy entity linked to this candidate history, if any.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Assigns a Vacancy entity to this candidate history.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Gets the name of the vacancy associated with the candidate, if provided.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Sets the vacancy name associated with this candidate history record.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Returns the Interview entity linked to this history, if any.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with this candidate history.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns an integer representing the action performed (e.g., interview scheduled, candidate rejected).

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the integer code representing the action.

methods.name: getPerformedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee responsible for the action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setPerformedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time of the action.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any additional notes attached to this history record.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Assigns notes to this document.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns a deprecated list of interviewers as a text string.

methods.name: setInterviewers
methods.description: Sets the list of interviewers as a text string (deprecated).
